components.label: Corrective lenses
components.blurb: The oldest mass-market body mod. Nobody calls you a cyborg for it. That's the point.

components.label: Smartwatch / fitness band
components.blurb: A sensor strapped to the wrist that tells you how you slept. You believe it over yourself.

components.label: Pacemaker / implant
components.blurb: Firmware inside the chest cavity. Heartbeat as a scheduled task.

components.label: Prosthetic limb
components.blurb: Body schema extends to fit the tool. The tool becomes body. Merleau-Ponty was early.

components.label: Daily medication
components.blurb: Chemistry-as-config. A dosage is a setting you don't get to hot-reload.

components.label: Shoes
components.blurb: Interface between foot and planet. Highly optimised, rarely considered.

components.label: Glasses (worn daily)
components.blurb: Vision is a rendering pipeline. You patched it.

components.label: Hearing aid / earbuds
components.blurb: Audio in, audio processed, audio out. The ear now has a DSP stage.

components.label: Phone camera as memory
components.blurb: You photograph the parking spot so you don't have to remember it. Memory offloaded to sensor.

components.label: GPS / maps
components.blurb: A satellite constellation tells you where you are. You've stopped checking.

components.label: Haptic notifications
components.blurb: A new sense: the buzz. It has no name in any pre-2007 language.

components.label: Dark mode / blue light filter
components.blurb: You tuned the colour temperature of reality between 21:00 and 07:00.

components.label: LLM assistant
components.blurb: A second cortex you rent. Draft-thinking outsourced; judgement hopefully not.

components.label: Web search
components.blurb: Transactive memory with a datacenter. You don't know it, you know where it is.

components.label: Notes app / second brain
components.blurb: An external hippocampus, tagged and searchable. Recall is now grep.

components.label: Calendar
components.blurb: Your sense of time is a shared .ics file. Miss the sync, miss the meeting.

components.label: Autocorrect / predictive text
components.blurb: A model finishes your sentences. Sometimes it's right. Sometimes it's ducking wrong.

components.label: Alarm clock
components.blurb: Circadian rhythm overridden by cron. The first automation most humans install.

components.label: A natural language
components.blurb: Language IS technology. You were compiled into one before you could consent.

components.label: A dialect / code-switching
components.blurb: Runtime selection of protocol based on who's listening. Dialect is a driver.

components.label: A programming language
components.blurb: You speak to machines in a grammar with no irregular verbs. It changed how you think.

components.label: Keyboard (touch-typing)
components.blurb: Thought exits through ten fingers at 80wpm. The keyboard has vanished from awareness.

components.label: Emoji / reactions
components.blurb: A pictographic layer bolted onto text. Tone, finally, has a codepoint.

components.label: Voice-to-text / dictation
components.blurb: Speech transcribed by a model, edited by a thumb. Two systems, one utterance.

components.label: Bicycle
components.blurb: The most efficient human-machine coupling ever shipped. Balance is done by the body-bike system.

components.label: Car
components.blurb: A two-tonne exoskeleton. You say 'I' when you mean 'the car'. ('Someone hit me.')

components.label: Public transit
components.blurb: Shared exoskeleton, timetable-driven. Assemblage at city scale.

components.label: Airplane (as passenger)
components.blurb: Pressurised tube, 11km up. You watched a film and forgot you were a payload.

components.label: Exoskeleton / e-mobility
components.blurb: Motors in the loop with your muscles. Closer to VADER than you'd like to admit.

components.label: E-bike / e-scooter
components.blurb: Battery-assisted legs. The hill is now a UI detail.

components.label: Messaging app
components.blurb: Your relationships have a transport layer. It has read receipts.

components.label: Social feed
components.blurb: An algorithm curates what you see of other humans. Steward it or be stewarded.

components.label: Contactless payments
components.blurb: Value transfers by proximity. Money became a gesture.

components.label: Digital ID / passport chip
components.blurb: Who you are, as far as the state is concerned, is an NFC read.

components.label: Shared calendars / invites
components.blurb: Other people can write to your time. Negotiate the permissions.

components.label: Figma / design tool
components.blurb: Your visual thinking lives in someone else's multiplayer canvas. Cmd+Z is part of your hand.

components.label: Pen & notebook
components.blurb: Ancient write-head. Still the lowest-latency thought interface available.

components.label: Terminal / shell
components.blurb: Text in, consequences out. The most honest interface: it tells you exactly what it did.

components.label: DAW / synth
components.blurb: Time-domain editing of sound. Undo for music. Bach didn't have that.

components.label: Guitar / instrument
components.blurb: Wood and wire that disappears when played. Peak transparent tool.

components.label: Camera (as craft)
components.blurb: Framing is a cognitive act performed through glass. You see differently with it on you.
